---
title: "Naming conventions"
description: ""
order: 3
---

Lines, crosses, seedlots and traits all follow set naming patterns. Consistent names are what let Breedbase link records, let us find seed and data years later, and let anyone in the lab read a name and know what it refers to.

::: {.callout-important}
If something doesn't fit these conventions, ask before creating a new code or format.
:::
